description: Append an exact new user instruction; invalidate old intent, concepts, plans and verification, preserving audit history.
name: brain_add_source

description: Opt-in gated AgentCAD call. Owner allowlist required. Default dry-run. A call_id permits at most one network write attempt; never retry uncertain outcomes.
name: brain_backend_call

description: Read the configured loopback AgentCAD live tool registry. Disabled unless CADMCP_AGENTCAD_URL is set by the owner.
name: brain_backend_probe

description: Choose one CAD adapter by required operations, observed readiness, project selection and free/owned cost policy. Read-only host dispatch plan; external probes are host observations. No CAD execution, settings writes or failure fallback.
name: brain_cad_route

description: Report local capabilities without pretending to test a remote CAD backend or a Windows/Cursor installation.
name: brain_doctor

description: Export immutable contract.json, CAD_HANDOFF.md and design_graph.json for the existing CAD backend. Does not execute CAD.
name: brain_export

description: Read exact original functional annotation and linked asset metadata. Labels are hypotheses, not verified engineering capabilities.
name: brain_fs_case

description: Compare actual materialized face-adjacency topology (WL) and surface geometry descriptors. Not a functional equivalence or automatic assembly proof.
name: brain_fs_compare

description: Return source-hashed function + geometry + topology evidence, usable in Concept.case_references. Requires original file integrity; no strength claims.
name: brain_fs_evidence

description: Inspect materialized planar/cylindrical surfaces. Distinguish inner cavity from solid shaft exterior; NOT proof of through-bore, fit, force transmission or fatigue.
name: brain_fs_interfaces

description: Reconstruct/import the registered real CAD; export STEP/STL/views and measure face-type graph, WL features and sampled geometry. Never invent geometry for missing UIDs.
name: brain_fs_materialize

description: Choose structurally diverse representatives from retrieved, measured CAD UIDs. Missing geometry is reported, not fabricated.
name: brain_fs_portfolio

description: Retrieve real CAD UIDs by functional keywords. Semantic is default and requires a prepared real model/index. Lexical mode must be explicitly requested. mode=geometry_encoder ranks by the in-house CAD-construction encoder (annotations unused); explicit only, no fallback, may be experimental.
name: brain_fs_search

description: Search multiple paraphrases per functional requirement without double-counting them. Inspect real surface preconditions; unknown geometry is not a pass. Explicit lexical mode is only a diagnostic/limited retrieval route.
name: brain_fs_search_tasks

description: Read actual function/asset/geometry coverage. An empty catalog is not an installed 128k library.
name: brain_fs_status

description: Issue the only Fusion adapter script allowed for this built subject. Host must pass it to fusion_mcp_execute unchanged. Does not save f3d. CadQuery remains the geometry referee.
name: brain_fusion_handoff

description: Accept Fusion print JSON only when it echoes the issued adapter. Remeasure overlap/clearance/motion in CadQuery. A Fusion screenshot is not a pass. f3d is not saved.
name: brain_fusion_ingest

description: Read current state and revision. Reload after REVISION_CONFLICT; never overwrite a newer design.
name: brain_get

description: Read durable project protection and effective legacy environment guards. No CAD/model execution or policy change.
name: brain_get_project_protection

description: Read the transactional project event history.
name: brain_history

description: Copy/hash a workspace-relative STEP. output needs current contract digest; reference performs actual kernel measurements and invalidates concepts/plans. Trusted local STEP only.
name: brain_import_step

description: User-selectable mesh backend per operation (hausdorff, simplify, fill_holes) for brain_mesh_ops, saved in THIS workspace only (.cadmcp/mesh-backend.json; other projects are never touched). action 'status' (read-only) lists every option with what it offers, where it runs, licence, limits, cost and live availability (numpy = studio code in this process; pymeshlab = separate scan python, GPL-3.0; cgal = separate cgal-mcp service over stdio JSON-RPC, never linked; Master 1.0.0 limits hausdorff / simplify to <= 400 faces). 'select' stores the user's choice (call only after the user chose), 'clear' removes it. Nothing is chosen automatically. The mouse scan-to-solid tools are not affected.
name: brain_mesh_backend

description: Generic mesh operation through the backend the USER selected (backend argument, else the saved brain_mesh_backend choice; neither => NEEDS_USER_CHOICE with the options, nothing runs). operation 'hausdorff' (relative_path vs other_path, symmetric, samples per mesh + vertices), 'simplify' (to target_faces; READY only if the independent deviation <= max_deviation_mm and no new holes), 'fill_holes' (EVERY boundary loop with <= max_hole_edges edges; selective filling is not offered; READY only if the source surface is preserved). Inputs: workspace-relative .stl / .obj, unit mm / cm / m required (output mm). Every mesh result is re-measured by the same studio exact-distance check (independent_check_numpy) so backends compare fairly; report fields backend, cgal_used, cgal (version, registry revision, plan / job id, validators), seconds. cgal refusals (e.g. PRECONDITION_FAILED above 400 faces) return REFUSED; an absent backend returns BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE; there is no silent fallback. Writes result.stl + mesh_ops_report.json once under mouse/mesh_ops/<mo_id>/ (never overwritten; sources never modified; same inputs return the stored report).
name: brain_mesh_ops

description: Hollow a READY scan into an open-bottom solid. route faceted_sdf (default): signed-distance shell, surface nets, one planar face per triangle (voxel_mm, max_faces, max_voxels). route smooth_fit: two fitted B-spline surfaces (outer skin = scan, inner skin = phi=-thickness) on the same rays + a planar ring on the opening plane; needs a scan that is star-shaped from the opening-section centroid and locally thicker than 2 x thickness (grid default 121, max 201; degree_min, degree_max, fit_tolerance_mm, smoothing). Routes never fall back to each other; checks report PASS/FAIL/UNVERIFIED and stop codes replace coarsening or loosening.
name: brain_mouse_build_shell_brep

description: Cut the click-panel slots and the wheel window into a closed shell solid STEP (B-rep). Layout = the brain_mouse_scan_click_grooves report (its slot_layout.json is used) or slot_layout.json written by it (click_slot_layout/1: open perimeter path + slot side, centre-gap segments, window corners) or a hand-written one in the same schema; geometry comes from the spec parameters (slot width, centre-gap width, depth below the local B-rep surface, window length/width/corner radius/depth), defaults from the layout. Floors follow the shell top surface minus the depth (smoothed), walls vertical, edges crisp; the window is a rounded-rectangle pocket with a flat floor parallel to its rim plane. Optional mirror plane: symmetry_report_path (brain_mouse_scan_symmetrise report, mirror_plane.json, or a report naming its symmetry report such as shell_fit) or mirror_plane {normal, d}, not both: the layout is symmetrised only where it passes the coarse mirror test (p80 residual <= max(abs_threshold_mm, rel_threshold x diag)); symmetry is never forced. Writes slotted_shell.step, slot_cutters.step and click_slots_report.json (checks: valid, one solid, removed volume, measured widths) once under mouse/cad/<cs_id>/; cached; the input STEP is never modified. Units mm.
name: brain_mouse_click_slots

description: Assign a role to every face of a mouse top-shell B-rep (and optional bottom plate) by GEOMETRY and write a colour-coded STEP (CAD stage; geometry is not changed). Inputs: shell_step_path = STEP with exactly one solid (workspace-relative), optional plate_step_path = STEP with one solid in the same frame (z up), optional hint_mesh_path (.stl) + hint_labels_path (.json {name: [triangle ids]} or .npz face_labels + codes 'name=code' as written by brain_mouse_recognize_shell / brain_mouse_scan_flush, names like left_click / right_click / side_button_1 / side_button_2 / wheel / top_shell, also LC RC B1 B2 WH; same frame), optional colors {panel|sidebutton|plate|rest: [r, g, b] sRGB 0..1} (defaults panel orange 0.95,0.50,0.10, side-button green 0.15,0.65,0.25, plate blue 0.20,0.40,0.85, rest grey 0.62,0.63,0.66). Method: samples on every face; a ray from p + 0.02 n along the outward normal against the same solid: most samples hit within slot_max_mm (default 2.5) => slot wall, within window_max_mm (default 30) => window wall; floors = faces bounded mostly by walls that rise above them (slot floor / window floor); every face rising from a window floor closes the pocket loop; walls without a floor or partner are demoted (warning). Side-button top = near-horizontal face bounded only by crisp edges (dihedral > crisp_edge_deg, default 15) to small walls that descend from it (protruding pad) => sidebutton + sidebutton_wall. parting = remaining down-facing faces (n_z < -0.5). panel = up-facing face bounded at least panel_min_groove_fraction (default 0.6) by groove / window walls that descend from it with the groove outside (a crisp front lip to the shell is allowed); the report gives its boundary length by neighbour role and the count of sample points outside its groove loop (must be 0). shell = the rest. Plate faces: role plate with sub floor (n_z < -0.9), parting (n_z > 0.3) or side. Hints: nearest labelled triangle of the face samples (within hint_max_dist_mm, default 1.5); a majority hint naming another top role is a FACE_ROLE_HINT_DISAGREES warning, the geometry role is kept. Writes face_roles.json (per solid: index in TopExp_Explorer order, role, sub, surface type, area, inner point, bbox, neighbours with shared length and dihedral), assembly_colored.step (XCAF face colours, read back and counted) and face_roles_report.json (counts per role, panel boundary composition, window loops, side-button pads, warnings, checks PASS / FAIL / UNVERIFIED) once under mouse/cad/<fr_id>/; never overwritten; the same inputs return the stored report. Fusion face indices may differ from the STEP order: match by point / bbox. Runs OCP in a subprocess of the server python (extra geometry); BREP_KERNEL_UNAVAILABLE without it. Stop codes: FACE_ROLES_FILE, FACE_ROLES_HINTS, FACE_ROLES_SETTINGS, FACE_ROLES_SHELL_SOLIDS, FACE_ROLES_PLATE_SOLIDS. Limits: flush or recessed side buttons stay shell; a groove wider than slot_max_mm reads as a window.
name: brain_mouse_face_roles

description: Read one stored board pack. Presence is not printability, optical alignment, or click-feel.
name: brain_mouse_get_board_pack

description: Read one stored shell pack. Registration is not printability, wall-thickness proof everywhere, or optical alignment.
name: brain_mouse_get_shell_pack

description: Flip a finished mouse between right-hand and left-hand by mirroring the WHOLE model about the mouse mirror plane (CAD stage; nothing is re-designed, the inputs are never modified). Inputs: shell_step_path = top shell STEP (one solid, e.g. side_buttons_shell.step), plate_step_path = bottom plate STEP (one solid, floor z = 0), face_roles_path = face_roles.json (or face_roles_report.json) of brain_mouse_face_roles for exactly these two files, and the mirror plane n.x = d given by symmetry_report_path (brain_mouse_scan_symmetrise report; JSON "plane") or mirror_normal + mirror_d (required; a built-in plane is never assumed; must be close to vertical). Method: plane mirror of both solids, then one rigid re-level (smallest rotation about the floor centroid that makes the best-fit mirrored floor plane horizontal, then a z shift so the floor is z = 0; a rigid map keeps shape and symmetry); a mirrored solid of negative volume is reversed to a valid orientation; the STEP files are written and read back and every gate is measured on them. Outputs under mouse/cad/<hf_id>/: top_shell.step, bottom_plate.step, assembly.step, assembly_colored.step (XCAF face colours from the roles: panel, side button, plate, rest; colors optional as in brain_mouse_face_roles), face_roles.json (same face order and roles, point / bbox re-measured; side-button roles now on the opposite flank), check_handedness_flip.json, handedness_flip_report.json. Gates (NOT_READY on FAIL): shell / plate valid one solid, assembly two valid solids, floor z = 0 within floor_tol_mm (default 0.001), volume within volume_tol_pct (default 0.1 %) of the source, side-button flank swapped (flank named left / right from front_direction, default +x front), face and role counts equal, every face the image of its source face, colours read back, shell-plate contact and non-overlap preserved. Generic: any handedness, any mirror plane tilt, no mouse constants. Same inputs return the stored report.
name: brain_mouse_handedness_flip

description: Hash workspace files and report board/shell pack status. A STEP on disk is not a ready shell. Does not invent fasteners or a passing design.
name: brain_mouse_inspect_inputs

description: Create a draft; call brain_mouse_knowledge_schema before validation.
name: brain_mouse_knowledge_brief

description: Evaluate compression bounds; read schema(click_window). Not a physical acceptance gate.
name: brain_mouse_knowledge_click_window

description: Read one complete mouse knowledge entry and its evidence.
name: brain_mouse_knowledge_get

description: Create CAD-agnostic staged guidance; call brain_mouse_knowledge_schema first.
name: brain_mouse_knowledge_plan

description: Return the standalone requirements schema and library metadata.
name: brain_mouse_knowledge_schema

description: Search source-grounded mouse knowledge; results are not fit evidence.
name: brain_mouse_knowledge_search

description: Read mouse-library coverage and evidence state; never opens CAD.
name: brain_mouse_knowledge_status

description: List draft and ready board packs in this workspace. Demo CAD cases are not listed here.
name: brain_mouse_list_board_packs

description: List draft and ready prepared-shell packs. A mesh scan is not listed here.
name: brain_mouse_list_shell_packs

description: Build the bottom plate under a given shell with ONE straight ruled side (CAD stage; the shell is never modified). Inputs: shell_step_path = STEP with one closed solid in the plate frame (floor z = 0); its parting face = the largest down-facing face (n_z < -0.5), the outer parting edge = that face's outer wire. Base outline source (same frame) by outline_mode: 'mesh' = scan STL sectioned at section_z_mm (largest closed loop; default auto = the lowest of 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, 1.5, 2.0 mm whose section is star-shaped about its centre and within 2 % in area of the next star-shaped one; every candidate is reported in outline_source), 'step' = lowest planar z = const face of a plate STEP (outer wire), 'polyline' = JSON {"points": [[x, y], ...]}. Optional mirror plane n.x = d: symmetry_report_path (JSON "plane": {"normal", "d"}, e.g. from brain_mouse_scan_symmetrise) or mirror_normal + mirror_d; without one nothing is symmetrised (the report says so). Method: the outline is split into n_sectors (default 24, even) angular sectors about its centroid on the mirror line, tested in mirror pairs with the same coarse test as the shell (p80 of the distance from mirrored points to the outline <= max(abs_thr_mm 2.0, rel_thr 0.015 x bbox diagonal)); near-symmetric pairs take the better side mirrored (lower curvature roughness) or the average when similar (ratio > similar_ratio 0.7), asymmetric pairs (side-button bulge, shifted half) stay as given, transitions blended; then a whole-loop polar LP fairing (min total variation of u + u'', u = 1/r, |delta r| <= max_change_mm 0.1), a periodic cubic spline and a clip inside the shell parting outline (inset >= min_inset_mm). Front (whole_v6 default): within front_blend_deg (default [38, 58] deg from the front, front = front_direction, default +x of the standard frame) the outline is replaced by the shell parting outline offset inward by a uniform front_rim_mm (default 1.2; 0 = follow the given outline), convex corners at least front_min_corner_radius_mm (default none = what the rim gives, ~10.3 mm on OP1), averaged with its mirror only when it passes the same coarse test; the measured rim and front corner radius are reported. Plate = floor z = 0 + exact copy of the shell parting surface (extended, general fuse) + ONE ruled side face (B-spline degree 3 x 1, periodic, n_stations rulings, default 1500, from the parting edge along its inward plan normal to the base outline; ruling order checked). Crisp edges: no fillets, hooks or waist. Checks on the re-imported STEP: plate valid, 1 solid, 3 faces, volume; overlap with the shell (0) and contact; plan protrusion beyond the shell parting outline <= 0.001 mm; plate top edge vs shell edge <= 0.01 mm; floor vs base outline; z = 0 outline change vs the source (radial, Hausdorff) and per-sector decisions; side profile r(z) monotonic on every ray; shell/plate edge angle and side-to-floor angle statistics; shell sha256 unchanged. READY only when every check passes. Writes bottom_plate.step, assembly.step (shell + plate), base_outline.json and plate_side_report.json once under mouse/cad/<pl_id>/ (never overwritten; same inputs return the stored report). Runs in a subprocess of the server python (OCP, scipy, shapely). Stop codes: PLATE_SIDE_NO_PARTING_FACE, PLATE_SIDE_OUTLINE, PLATE_SIDE_OUTLINE_NOT_STAR_SHAPED, PLATE_SIDE_RULINGS_CROSS, PLATE_SIDE_BUILD, PLATE_SIDE_SYMMETRY.
name: brain_mouse_plate_side

description: Inspect a closed scan mesh (STL/OBJ) for scan-to-shell stage A1: unit (required, never guessed), topology, orientation, components, holes. Only allow-listed repairs run (all default off) and each is reported. Writes mouse/scans/<scan_id>/; READY or NOT_READY with reasons. Self-intersection stays UNVERIFIED.
name: brain_mouse_prepare_scan

description: Find left click, right click, scroll wheel, side button 1 and 2 and the palm shell on a READY prepared scan (best on the full-resolution cleaned STL). Frame, front/rear, base and right/left-hand mouse are detected from the mesh (handedness auto|right|left). Returns per-region face count, area, bbox, a high/med/low confidence and a note for every boundary stretch that is inferred rather than supported by a groove; writes face labels (hashed) and optional top/flank overlay PNGs under mouse/scans/<scan_id>/regions/. NOT_READY for a mesh that is not welded/closed. Surface-only: hinges, switches and the wheel axle are not visible and are not inferred. Calibrated on an OP1-class mouse; no CAD is generated.
name: brain_mouse_recognize_regions

description: Find the bottom plate, top shell, parting seam and sensor window on a READY prepared scan (runs brain_mouse_recognize_regions first; the click, wheel and side-button faces are excluded from the top shell). Geometry only (no texture): the seam is the groove of the outer wall found by a circular path search over 1 degree azimuth bins; bins without a clear groove (typically the rear) are interpolated and listed as inferred, with a supported fraction and a confidence. The sensor window is the deep pocket in the underside (centre and size in the work frame mm and in the canonical frame, depth above the fitted plate plane). Writes hashed face labels (bottom_plate=1, top_shell=2) and seam / sensor outlines under mouse/scans/<scan_id>/shell/. S1.3 hand-off: labels.npz (one file: bottom_plate, top_shell, left_click, right_click, wheel, side_button_1, side_button_2) and canonical.stl (the prepared mesh in the mesh-derived canonical frame x front, y mouse-left, z up, same face order; 4x4 scan_to_canonical in the report) are the inputs of brain_mouse_scan_flush. Surface-only: the sensor PCB and chip behind the window are not visible. No CAD is generated.
name: brain_mouse_recognize_shell

description: Store a typed PCB mechanical pack. Ready status is refused when required fields are unverified, hashes mismatch, or the STEP is not a valid B-rep.
name: brain_mouse_register_board_pack

description: Store a typed prepared-shell pack. Ready status needs a protected outer envelope, a positive wall thickness, matching STEP hash, and a valid B-rep. Scan-to-shell conversion is not performed.
name: brain_mouse_register_shell_pack

description: Fill the cable hole / USB pocket of the scan front wall with the PLAIN wall inferred from the trusted wall around it (mesh stage, optional; no CAD is generated). The scanned pocket is grade-C data and the designed front wall is straight or a gentle R, so the pocket is discarded, not followed. Generic: any mouse, wired or wireless, any pocket position, asymmetric allowed; no mouse-specific coordinates. Inputs: relative_path = welded STL in the standard frame (x front, y left, z up; typically flushed.stl of brain_mouse_scan_flush; unit required, never guessed; output mm), optional labels_path = .json {region: [face ids]} or .npz face_labels + codes (hints only: exclude_regions, default wheel / side buttons / sensor, are never trusted wall nor filled; the click labels choose the front side, default +x). Method: front height field x(y, z) by rays over a grid_mm grid (faces within front_depth_mm of the front); trusted wall = front-facing hits (n_x > front_nx); wall S = Gaussian-weighted local quadratic regression (detect_sigma_mm) with one-sided trimming; recess = S - x >= min_depth_mm (or an enclosed no-hit cell = through hole); opening with a min_width_mm disk keeps grooves / parting slits out; pockets = components >= min_area_mm2. Per pocket: polynomial wall x = P(y, z) of total degree `degree` fitted robustly to the ring_mm trusted ring (recesses trimmed); pocket faces (footprint + margin_mm and the connected walls below P) removed, the boundary loop (must be simple in the front view; folded rim faces are removed until it is) triangulated (constrained Delaunay + longest-edge bisection to patch_edge_mm), lifted onto P with the loop residual blended out over blend_mm, oriented outward and labelled with the nearest rim region. Report per pocket: area (front view), y / z range, fill depth max / mean, fill volume, ring fit p50 / p95 / max, wall vs surrounding p95, minimum principal radius of P, faces removed / patch faces, seam dihedral, loop residual. READY = no pocket (no-op: mesh and labels copied unchanged) or every pocket filled; NOT_READY (no filled mesh written): CABLE_FRONT_WALL_NOT_FOUND, CABLE_INFERRED_WALL_NOT_SMOOTH (ring fit p95 > smooth_tol_mm or radius < min_radius_mm), CABLE_RING_INCOMPLETE, CABLE_POCKET_TOO_LARGE (> max_area_mm2), CABLE_LOOP_NOT_SIMPLE. Writes filled.stl (kept faces in input order, then the patch), labels (.npz or .json like the input), cable_fill.npz (grid, height field, wall, pocket mask, face_source) and cable_fill_report.json once under mouse/scans/<cf_id>/ (never overwritten; same inputs return the stored report). Next: brain_mouse_scan_symmetrise on filled.stl + labels, then brain_mouse_shell_fit / brain_mouse_shell_solid; brain_mouse_plate_side outline_path = filled.stl. Runs in the separate scan python (env CADMCP_SCAN_PYTHON; numpy, scipy, trimesh, shapely >= 2.1); SCAN_PYTHON_MISSING without it.
name: brain_mouse_scan_cable_fill

description: Re-cut under-resolved grooves, or fill explicit messy zones, on a READY scan (give scan_id = a prepared scan or a brain_mouse_scan_model model_id, or relative_path + unit of an STL/OBJ; the full-resolution cleaned STL gives the best result). mode grooves: each groove (0.6-1.2 mm wide, about the mesh edge length) is fitted as a 3D B-spline centre line (open or closed) with a piecewise-constant width / depth profile (trapezoid cut between two quadratic skins; steps explicit), faces round it are subdivided and moved along the surface normal to the fitted profile. Seeds are the region boundaries of brain_mouse_recognize_regions (click gap, click rim, side-button pad rings; wheel excluded), or the grooves override [{name, points [[x, y, z] mm], closed}]. Stations whose fit fails or whose groove is shallower than 0.05 mm are left original. design_intent=true (open grooves only; optional per-groove straight in the grooves override) REPLACES the groove by a clean one: smoothed low-curvature centre line (straight where the fitted centres are), one constant width / depth (robust median of the trusted stations, reported), skins refitted from the trusted surface, displacement up to max_zone_deviation_mm; the report lists stations fitted / rebuilt by intent / left original and whether the cap binds; undercut slits behind a lip are not rebuilt. mode zones: zones [{name, box {min, max} and / or faces [ids]}] are filled from their surroundings (moving least squares, tapered, displacement capped at max_zone_deviation_mm, default 0.6); it smooths and can erase real features and does not rebuild grooves. Writes cleaned.stl, cleaned.ply, groove_params.json (centre-line control points, widths, depths, step positions; mm, prepared-scan frame) and a report with per-groove deviation, roughness before / after, watertight / manifold / winding verified on the written STL, outside-zone deviation against outside_tolerance_mm (default 0.05) and self-intersection counts (UNVERIFIED unless zero) under mouse/scans/<clean_id>/. Runs numpy / scipy / PyMeshLab (GPL-3.0) in a subprocess from a separate python (env CADMCP_SCAN_PYTHON; SCAN_PYTHON_MISSING when absent). Never modifies the source and never overwrites outputs; stop codes (SCAN_CLEAN_NO_GROOVE_SEEDS, SCAN_CLEAN_NOTHING_EDITED, ...) replace loosening. Limits are listed in the report (floor shape unresolved at the edge length, loops and steps only partly clean, no CAD is generated).
name: brain_mouse_scan_clean

description: Rebuild the click-panel grooves of a welded scan mesh as clean rectangular slots (mesh stage; no CAD is generated). Inputs: relative_path = watertight welded STL in the standard frame (x front, y left, z up, bottom plate at z 0; unit required, never guessed; output mm) and labels_path = .json {region: [face ids]} (names left_click / right_click / wheel, optional top_shell, bottom_plate, side_button_1/2; also LC RC WH B1 B2) or .npz face_labels + codes from the recognition steps. Method: fit the start lines from the data (centre gap = one averaged straight line per click, merged when the clicks meet; perimeter = outer ring of the closed click outline as averaged straight pieces with fillets, radius fitted unless fillet_radius_mm is given), cut vertical-walled flat-floor slots of slot_width_mm per panel side (default 0.5 mm; the centre gap is the union, about 1.0 mm; panel_overlap_mm 0.2 reaches into the panel so the edge is cut clean) to slot_depth_mm below the smoothed panel surface (default 2.0 mm), shift the perimeter slot outward until it cannot encroach on the panel edge (perimeter_clearance_mm margin), remove the wheel and rebuild its window as a rounded rectangle fitted to the RIM of the wheel well (geometry: top height field without the wheel faces, pixels deeper than 0.8 mm below the plane of a ring round the label hole, opened by 1 mm so the centre gap does not leak in; falls back to the label hole with warning WINDOW_RIM_FROM_LABELS) with a floor parallel to the rim (rebuild_window, needs the wheel label; brain_mouse_click_slots window_length_mm / window_width_mm / window_radius_mm override it), exact boolean (manifold3d), weld, drop degenerate faces / zero-volume flaps / detached splinters, verify one watertight body. Cut-through (slot floor leaving the original solid) is allowed and reported per run; min_wall_mm > 0 raises floors instead. Writes combined_grooved.stl, one STL per labelled region, slot_layout.json (plan start lines of the perimeter slot and centre gap, slot side, window corners / radius / rim and floor planes; input of brain_mouse_click_slots), click_grooves_report.json (widths, depths, flatness, wall verticality, centre-gap width, cut-through list, bodies, watertight before / after, volume removed, fit results) and optional before_after.png under mouse/scans/<groove_id>/; never overwrites; the same inputs return the stored report. Runs in the separate scan python (env CADMCP_SCAN_PYTHON) with numpy, scipy, trimesh, shapely and manifold3d (extra scan-grooves); CLICK_GROOVE_KERNEL_UNAVAILABLE when a library is missing, SCAN_PYTHON_MISSING without the python. Stop codes: CLICK_GROOVE_REGIONS_MISSING, CLICK_GROOVE_MESH_NOT_WATERTIGHT, CLICK_GROOVE_NO_GAP, CLICK_GROOVE_FRAME, CLICK_GROOVE_CUTTER_INVALID. G1.4: the perimeter start line is regularised (straight pieces merged against noise kinks / waves, per-vertex fillet radii = tangent arcs, G1), mirrored from the better click branch where near-symmetric (coarse test per piece, symmetry_tol 1.5 mm; never forced), the window is a rounded rectangle centred on the centre-gap line; optional symmetry_report_path (brain_mouse_scan_symmetrise report) snaps the gap line onto the mirror plane when within 2 mm. Gates (NOT_READY): PERIMETER_OUTLINE_ROUGH (smoothed-fit deviation > 0.02 mm or curvature sign changes), WINDOW_OFF_GAP_LINE, PANEL_LABEL_OVERHANG_TOO_LARGE.
name: brain_mouse_scan_click_grooves

description: Flush a welded scan mesh onto its bottom plate (mesh stage; no CAD is generated). Inputs: relative_path = watertight welded STL already in the standard frame (x front, y left, z up; unit required, never guessed; output mm), optional labels_path = .json {region: [face ids]} or .npz face_labels + codes with a bottom_plate region (without it the dominant down-facing plane of the whole mesh is used, with a warning). Method: area-weighted RANSAC plane on the down-facing plate faces (inlier band plate_tolerance_mm, default 0.12), refit on the inliers, minimal rotation that makes the plate normal +z, plate shifted onto z = 0; skates/feet that protrude below end up at negative z (reported, never clipped). Rigid transform only; face order is unchanged so the same labels stay valid. Returns the transform (Rm, z_shift, 4x4) and residual stats: plane-fit area and rms, tilt before/after, percentage of plate area within plate_tolerance_mm of z = 0, protrusion below the plate. Writes flushed.stl, flush_transform.json, a copy of the labels and flush_report.json once under mouse/scans/<flush_id>/ (never overwritten; same inputs return the stored report). Pass flushed.stl and the copied labels to brain_mouse_scan_click_grooves. Runs in the separate scan python (numpy, trimesh); PyMeshLab is not used.
name: brain_mouse_scan_flush

description: Turn a PLY scan into cleaned, decimated, watertight STL files for brain_mouse_prepare_scan. unit is required (never guessed); output is mm. Vertices are welded by exact position first (textured PLY files carry fake UV seams), then topology-only cleanup, then quadric decimation searched to the smallest face count within target_max_error_mm (two-sided Hausdorff vs the welded original; hard_limit_error_mm is the fallback). Watertight, manifold and winding are verified on the written STL; thin-wall zones are reported separately and are not part of the budget. Runs PyMeshLab (GPL-3.0) as a subprocess in a separate python (env CADMCP_SCAN_PYTHON), never in this process; SCAN_PYTHON_MISSING when absent. Never modifies the source and never overwrites outputs (mouse/scans/<model_id>/). Self-intersection stays UNVERIFIED.
name: brain_mouse_scan_model

description: Build the side-button pads (raised, crisp) with a groove round each on a closed top-shell STEP (CAD stage; normally slotted_shell.step of brain_mouse_click_slots) and write a NEW STEP. Inputs: shell_step_path (one solid, mm), mesh_path = scan STL in the same frame (e.g. flushed.stl of brain_mouse_scan_flush; a report path pairs its STL + labels) and labels_path (.npz face_labels + codes or .json {name: [triangle ids]}; names side_button_1 / side_button_2 / sidebutton* / B1..B4; labels.npz next to the mesh is paired automatically; labels are hints), optional regions_report_path (brain_mouse_recognize_regions report: per-button confidence + handedness), optional reference_images (workspace image paths, recorded for the reviewer, not analysed). Generic: 0..max_per_flank (default 2) buttons per flank, any handedness, never mirrored; without labels raised flank patches (> top_threshold_mm above the skin) are detected (confidence medium). Per button: push direction = mean skin normal; outline = convex hull of the scan points > top_threshold_mm (default 0.35) above the skin, simplified (outline_tol_mm 0.35), straight edges re-fitted, corners filleted (corner_radius_mm 1.0; mild turns blended), one periodic B-spline edge; top = quadratic fit of the scan pad top when the confidence is high, else skin + default_proud_mm (1.0; v6-style default, status REVIEW); proud_mm forces a fixed protrusion; groove = outline offset groove_width_mm (0.4) to groove_depth_mm (1.5) below the skin (both 0 = plain raised pad). Gates (NOT_READY): SIDE_BUTTONS_TOO_MANY, SIDE_BUTTON_NOT_ON_FLANK, SIDE_BUTTON_SKIN_DISCONTINUOUS (edge / slot / hole under the button), SIDE_BUTTON_PROUD_OUT_OF_RANGE, SIDE_BUTTONS_OVERLAP, brep_valid, one_solid, reimport, no_slivers, outline_regular, groove_as_specified, pad_proud. Writes side_buttons_shell.step, side_buttons.json (per-button frame + outline) and side_buttons_report.json (per button: flank, confidence + reasons, outline size / radii, scan vs used protrusion, measured groove width / depth and protrusion on the re-imported STEP) once under mouse/cad/<sb_id>/; cached; the input STEP is never modified. Next: brain_mouse_plate_side / brain_mouse_face_roles on outputs.shell (pads read as sidebutton + sidebutton_wall). Units mm.
name: brain_mouse_scan_side_buttons

description: Detect the mirror plane of a welded scan mesh and correct scan error ONLY where the part is really symmetric (mesh stage; no CAD is generated). Symmetry is never forced. Inputs: relative_path = welded STL (any frame, typically the flushed frame of brain_mouse_scan_flush; unit required, never guessed; output mm), optional labels_path = .json {region: [face ids]} or .npz face_labels + codes; labels are hints only (they group faces for the report and pair a region with its mirror counterpart), the geometry test decides. Method: robust best-fit mirror plane (plane_search lateral = start from the y axis of the standard frame x front / y left / z up, default; pca = try the three principal axes, best median residual wins; hint = start from normal_hint), soft-L1 point-to-tangent-plane residual of mirrored samples plus a trimmed refit, so one-sided features barely bias it); coarse test per region AND per local cell (cell_mm, default max(8 mm, 8 % of the bbox diagonal), cells on folded coordinates): statistic = p80 of the unbounded vertex-to-mirrored-surface distance, threshold = max(abs_threshold_mm 2.0, rel_threshold 0.015 x bbox diagonal); a region is ASYMMETRIC when its statistic exceeds the threshold or more than half of its cells fail; no usable plane when the global statistic exceeds 2 x threshold (NOT_READY, mesh unchanged). Only passing regions and cells are corrected: vertices move along their normal toward the mirrored counterpart (average both sides when their roughness is similar, otherwise mirror the better side; correspondences farther than correspondence_cap_mm 1.0 ignored; passes 3; displacement ramps to 0 over ramp_mm next to kept faces). Kept as scanned: failing cells and regions (real design asymmetry such as a thumb rest, a shifted half, side buttons), fixed_regions (default wheel, side buttons, sensor) and faces whose mirror image lands on them, exclude_regions (default bottom_plate). Face order and topology are unchanged, so the input labels stay valid. Writes symmetrised.stl, symmetry_mask.npz (asymmetric / fixed / symmetrised faces, vertex displacement), mirror_plane.json and symmetry_report.json (plane normal . x = d in the input frame, threshold, per-region statistic / cells / counterpart / decision, per-pair correction and residual before / after) once under mouse/scans/<sy_id>/ (never overwritten; same inputs return the stored report). The report is the symmetry source of brain_mouse_plate_side and brain_mouse_shell_fit. Runs in the separate scan python (env CADMCP_SCAN_PYTHON; numpy, scipy, trimesh); SCAN_PYTHON_MISSING without it.
name: brain_mouse_scan_symmetrise

description: Fit the outer skin of a scan shell region as a fair, CAD-grade B-spline surface (no scan copy: short waviness is rejected on purpose). Inputs: relative_path = welded STL (typically symmetrised.stl of brain_mouse_scan_symmetrise; unit required, never guessed; output mm), labels_path + regions (default ['top_shell']; labels are hints that select the domain), symmetry source = symmetry_report_path (brain_mouse_scan_symmetrise report: plane normal . x = d and per-region decisions) or mirror_plane {normal, d}, optional cut_planes [{normal, d}] (keep normal . x <= d; at most 3; e.g. a front cut where another tool builds the front). front_cut auto (default; used only when cut_planes is empty): the full domain is fitted first; when that is not READY, the most forward cut plane perpendicular to the mirror plane along the input x axis (standard frame, x front; front side = side of the click labels) whose fit is READY is chosen by a coarse scan backwards in front_cut_step_mm (default 3) and a 0.5 mm forward refinement; the chosen cut and every candidate are reported (front_cut, cut_planes_used) and stored in shell_surface.json for brain_mouse_shell_solid; front_cut none keeps the full domain. Symmetry is never forced: mode auto fits HALF + mirror only when every domain region is symmetric in the report (mode half refuses otherwise: SHELL_FIT_NOT_SYMMETRIC), else ONE face over the full region; fit_side auto takes the half with the larger region area (fewer feature holes). Method: domain cut exactly at the mirror / cut planes, ears removed, jagged label boundary smoothed and re-projected, feature holes bridged with zero fit weight; four corners = ends of the plane sides + boundary turning > 35 deg (>= 5 mm apart), a 3-corner domain gets a scored 4th corner on its longest free side; harmonic (cotan) map to the unit square; KKT-constrained least squares, degree (default 3), spans_u x spans_v (default 10 x 6) capped so the knot spacing is >= min_wavelength_mm / 2 (default 10 mm: no ripple shorter than about 10 mm can be represented), thin-plate smoothing (default 1e-7), plane sides exactly on their plane, mirror G0 + G1 (cross tangent along the plane normal, so G2 across the mirror), Gauss-Newton parameter correction; OCP Geom_BSplineSurface, mirror copy, sewing, STEP. Checks: deviation p95 <= tol_p95_mm (0.2) and max <= tol_max_mm (1.0) against the domain points, independent OCP projection check, other half mirrored vs the fit, mirror G0 / G1, flipped parameter area <= 0.1 %, minimum parameter angle >= 10 deg, fairness (mean-curvature gradient, kmax), valid sewn B-rep; READY only when all pass. Writes shell_skin.step (open skin) and shell_surface.json (degree, knots, poles in the input frame) and shell_fit_report.json once under mouse/cad/<sf_id>/ (never overwritten; same inputs return the stored report). Limits: one four-sided face per half (no interior crease split), the skin is not closed to a solid and has no crisp lip (brain_mouse_shell_solid closes it). Runs in the server python (OCP, scipy, trimesh).
name: brain_mouse_shell_fit

description: Close a brain_mouse_shell_fit skin to a CLOSED top-shell solid (B-rep, mm). Input: shell_fit_report_path = a half + mirror shell_fit report with exactly one front cut (front_cut auto or one cut_planes entry); the mesh, labels (override labels_path), unit and cut are taken from it. layout_path (optional) = slot_layout.json or the brain_mouse_scan_click_grooves report: the groove bands next to the click slots and the wheel window are kept out of the crease and cap fits. Labels are hints: shell_regions (default top_shell, left_click, right_click), plate_regions (bottom_plate ...), exclude_regions (wheel, side buttons, sensor; exclude margin 2.5 mm). Method in the frame of the mirror plane and the cut: plan silhouette of the front from the trusted scan, crease line (side panel / front lip) measured per 1 mm station from the normals (top quadratic x wall line), robust symmetric smoothing, snapped to the skin; front tube (flanks + PLAIN front wall: lip band of lip_band_mm below the crease and recesses deeper than trim_inward_mm such as the cable hole are not followed; front_stiffness) with exact G0 / G1 to the skin at both ends; cap = MakeFilling, G1 to the skin and to the tube near the ends, C0 along the rest of the crease = a crisp lip edge made by intersecting faces; parting surface: parting_mode auto = z-const plane (median seam height or parting_z_mm) when the fitted shell / plate seam is flat within flat_tolerance_mm (0.3), else the fitted seam height field; seam | plane force one. The skin + tube + cap are sewn and closed with the parting surface (MakerVolume); the interior volume is kept. Checks: skin READY, valid, one closed solid, no face smaller than min_face_area_mm2, STEP re-import valid + tessellates, no multiple edges, scan deviation p95 <= tol_p95_mm (front includes the cable hole and grooves on purpose). Writes top_shell_solid.step, front_construction.npz (crease, plan) and shell_solid_report.json once under mouse/cad/<ss_id>/ (never overwritten; same inputs return the stored report). Next: brain_mouse_click_slots on top_shell_solid.step. Limits: half + mirror skins and one front cut only; slots, wheel window and side buttons are not cut here. Runs in the server python (OCP, scipy).
name: brain_mouse_shell_solid

description: Report whether a ready board pack and a ready shell pack exist. Does not generate structure CAD, bosses, or click parts.
name: brain_mouse_structure_gate

description: Start source-grounded design. request is the user's exact original text, not an invented paraphrase. Next call brain_task.
name: brain_open

description: Retrieve original mechanism patterns using lexical English/Japanese search. Results are not validated designs or dimensional allowables.
name: brain_patterns

description: List saved project IDs/revisions. Legacy next_stage does not describe Studio builds; use brain_studio_attempts for prototype history.
name: brain_projects

description: Read a versioned Brief, Concept, Concepts or Plan JSON schema.
name: brain_schema

description: Select a gate-eligible concept. This does not attest human approval, printability, strength or fatigue life.
name: brain_select

description: Explicit owner-directed policy change only, never an automatic repair. Replaces project protection, records before/after and reason, advances revision. Get ProjectProtection via brain_schema. Caller identity/owner approval must be enforced by the host; a reason is not authentication. Can remove protection or grant editing, so requires approval review.
name: brain_set_project_protection

description: List persisted Studio subjects and current/stale revisions. Recorded geometry verdicts are history, not freshly verified evidence. Use review_status to recheck hashes.
name: brain_studio_attempts

description: Build a STEP-bound typed CAD recipe in a separate process; export real STEP/STL/SVG and static/sampled-motion clearance. No arbitrary Python exec, printer send or canonical project modification.
name: brain_studio_build

description: Inspect supported CAD operations/checks before planning. Unsupported is not impossible or pass; returns explicit limitations and next actions. No CAD/model execution.
name: brain_studio_capabilities

description: Generate DELIVERY.json and DELIVERY.md for one verified subject. Missing BOM/physical proof remains explicit; canonical CAD is not modified.
name: brain_studio_delivery

description: Record an evidence-based response to a specific review finding. No majority vote or prose rebuttal automatically clears a blocker.
name: brain_studio_reply

description: Prepare a requirements/mechanism/assembly/manufacturing/verification reviewer packet with real evidence and exact output schema. This does NOT spawn an independent LLM itself.
name: brain_studio_review_packet

description: Read review coverage, open disagreements, geometry failures and unverified physical requirements. Reviewer independence and human approval are never inferred.
name: brain_studio_review_status

description: Get FunctionBrief, Matrix, Recipe, Review, Reply, AcceptanceSpec, BoardPack, ShellPack, FusionHandoff or FusionReport schemas. These are typed host/worker contracts, not a claim of semantic intelligence.
name: brain_studio_schema

description: Record actual host-submitted engineering findings for this revision and subject. Roles and agreement never authenticate independent reviewers or clear physical tests.
name: brain_studio_submit_review

description: Combine real-reference mechanism options into compatible functional covers. Reject absent required surfaces and invented face IDs. Returns review subjects, NOT finished assemblies.
name: brain_studio_synthesize

description: Measure the exact registered STEP against additional geometric criteria in a bounded worker. Create a new evidence subject without regenerating CAD or copying reviews. Original checks, failures and unverified requirements remain; this is not physical certification or owner approval.
name: brain_studio_verify_artifact

description: Commit 2–4 distinct FBS mechanism alternatives and return mechanical/declaration gate results for each.
name: brain_submit_concepts

description: Validate and commit the source-linked Brief. Reject source omissions, fabricated quotations, contradictory constraints and mandatory inferences.
name: brain_submit_intent

description: Commit a typed geometric construction plan with dependency, provenance and test-obligation validation.
name: brain_submit_plan

description: Get the next host-model task, relevant state and exact JSON schema. The server does not pretend to understand natural language itself.
name: brain_task

description: Measure imported B-reps and evaluate listed geometry checks. Missing/stale/unsupported evidence remains unknown; physical performance is not certified.
name: brain_verify
